data.name: PrivacyBody
data.value:
Data controller
Charles Nicollas, publisher of the site ({0}).

Data collected

  • A login chosen at registration, visible to other players in the leaderboards.
  • An email address, stored encrypted in the database and used only for registration confirmation, password reset and address change.
  • A password, never stored in clear text (hashed).
  • IP addresses: the one used at registration, the one of each login and the one of each game guess, for security purposes and to fight fraud and multiple accounts.
  • Your game history (guesses, scores, badges, current streak).
  • Messages you send through the site's messaging and, where applicable, the players you submit (your login may appear as the submitter of the player of the day).

Purposes
This data is used solely to run the game (accounts, leaderboards, badges) and to keep the service secure (fraud prevention, password reset). It is neither sold, nor handed over, nor used for advertising.

Legal basis
Performance of the contract (providing the service) for account data, legitimate interest for security and fraud prevention (IP addresses).

Recipients and processors
Only the publisher accesses the data. It is processed by technical providers: the site host (OVH), an email delivery provider (registration confirmation, password reset) and the "Have I Been Pwned" service, queried when you choose a password to check it has not been leaked: only the first 5 characters of a fingerprint of the password are sent, never the password itself nor your identity. This last service may be located outside the European Union.

Retention
Account and game data is kept as long as the account exists. IP addresses are automatically erased after 12 months. Deleting the account, on request, deletes the associated data.

Your rights
Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, object to and port your data. You can exercise these rights by email at {0}, or through the site's messaging from your account. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr).

Security
The email address is encrypted in the database, passwords are hashed (never stored in clear text), and account access goes through an authenticated login.

Minimum age
The service is intended for people aged 15 or over.

data.name: CookiesBody
data.value:
The site only uses cookies and local storage that are strictly necessary for it to work or that store preferences you choose:

  • an authentication cookie, to keep you signed in;
  • a security cookie protecting against fraudulent form submissions;
  • a language preference cookie;
  • a cookie and local storage remembering the announcements you have hidden or collapsed.

No audience measurement, advertising or tracking cookie is used. As these are strictly necessary or tied to a choice you make, they do not require prior consent.
